purpose: Least-privilege root mutation contract for CYNIC network repair. The policy constrains privileged network changes to a single helper surface and explicit profile allowlists.

allowed_profiles.purpose: restore temporary provider fallback route for resurrection only
restore canonical Synapse route on this node
activate canonical WireGuard mesh on this node

postflight: cynic-node network evidence --json captured after apply
postflight status does not degrade relative to preflight
mutation record includes exact argv and selected profile
denial: commands outside the helper sudoers rule fail non-interactively
raw ip/wg/nmcli commands are absent from sudoers
shell execution through helper is forbidden and tested
